verdict.rationale: Gmail's snooze feature is documented (temporarily removes an email and presumably resurfaces it later), which covers the 'snooze conversations' part of the story. However, there is no evidence of an automated follow-up reminder feature that resurfaces a thread specifically when nobody replies (e.g., Gmail's 'Nudge' feature is not mentioned in the pack). missing for 10: explicit documentation of reply-tracking follow-up reminders/nudges, evidence of automatic resurfacing tied to thread inactivity, independent corroboration of this behavior.
